summary: Per-frame tire temperature simulation on a vehicle. Skips entirely for vehicle types greater than 1. Gated by SessionStateCheckWrapper on the session state object dword_7CD25C. Clamps the temperature field this+0x48B8 to [0.0, 5.0], subtracts the cooling rate dbl_8AFE90, and when the result drops to zero recovers it via ClampedPhysicsScaleWithThreshold using the team field this+0x4894, choosing the larger of -scale and scale+temp. Then dispatches car lighting/render through a 432-byte-strided ring buffer (dword_83EE60 count, dword_8AAE64 write pointer) and runs sub_4EF2E0 on this+3. Called by IterateVehicles (004B3BA0).

operations.description: Skips the function entirely when the vehicle type this+0x32C8 is greater than 1 (only types 0 and 1 simulated)
SessionStateCheckWrapper on dword_7CD25C gates the temperature simulation on active session state; when it returns zero the simulation is skipped
Clamps the tire temperature field this+0x48B8 into [0.0, 5.0]
Subtracts the cooling rate dbl_8AFE90 from the temperature and stores the result back to this+0x48B8

When the cooled temperature is <= 0, computes a clamped physics scale via ClampedPhysicsScaleWithThreshold using the team field this+0x4894 and -1.0, then recovers the temperature to max(-scale, scale + temp)
Ring-buffer dispatch: count dword_83EE60 is capped at 1023; otherwise it increments and the write pointer dword_8AAE64 advances by 432 bytes, then SetupCarLightingAndRender runs on the selected entry
Follow-up call to sub_4EF2E0 on the sub-object at this+3 after the lighting/render dispatch
Invoked by IterateVehicles (004B3BA0) as part of the per-frame vehicle pass
